purpose.zh: 慢慢往前倒再拉回来，练大腿后面的劲，少拉伤
purpose.en: Lower slowly and pull back up to build the backs of your thighs and help prevent strains.

text.zh: 膝盖到头一条线，越慢越好地往前倒
text.en: Knees to head in one line, lower forward as slowly as you can

text.zh: 脚后跟勾紧，两手护在胸前。
text.en: Heels hooked in, hands up in front of your chest.

text.zh: 大腿后面使劲，把身子拉回直立。
text.en: Use the backs of your thighs to pull yourself back upright.

commonErrors.zh: 屁股往后撅，身子折起来
commonErrors.en: Sticking your butt out and folding at the hips.

cautions.zh: 刚开始只往前倒一点；大腿后面拉伤过的先问医生或康复师
cautions.en: Start by lowering only a little. If you've strained a hamstring before, check with a doctor or physio first.
